req.title: Create requires title
req.statement: The system shall render 'Title is required.' when POST /create omits the title field.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return a specific error message when the title field is omitted in a POST request to /create. This behavior needs to be validated through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_create_post_without_title
actions: Send POST request to /create without title
expected: Error message 'Title is required.' is flashed
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as a valid user
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

# Attempt to create a post without a title
r = client.post('/create', data={'body': 'This is a test body without a title.'})

assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Title is required.' in r.data

tests.name: test_create_post_with_title
actions: Send POST request to /create with valid title and body
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as a valid user
